description:
The saltwater crocodile is the largest reptile alive, and every reason it's terrifying in this video is real: dives that last for hours, a face that feels a single drop of water, a tongue built for the open sea, a 411 km swim home after being moved away, the death roll, and a comeback that brought it back into a city's harbour. Doug meets every one of them.

Which saltwater crocodile fact would keep you out of the water? Tell us in the comments.
Subscribe so you don't miss Doug's next bad decision.
